notices: This is a public metadata view: no private ledger, credentials, ChatGPT conversation URLs, or user data.
PR states are fetched live from public GitHub when this page loads; they are unknown if fetching fails.
Scope may be amended during development only with an auditable owner decision; integration checks run against the final merged SHA.
Merged is not automatically integration-proven. A separate proof PR records passing checks, gaps and any required migrations.
